name: City Journey 03 · Skate Escape

signs.text: RIDE NORTH: Steer with WASD / arrows. Space jumps; Shift brakes. Hold G / Grind near a rail to latch. Gold ramps launch over walls.
JAM COURT: Cross the stopped traffic gaps. Roaches and riders occupy the sidewalk; the long left rail is optional.
HIGHWAY RAILS: Blue entry ramps climb above traffic. Hold G at the gold rail to latch. Space jumps off, Shift releases. Ground crossings stay dangerous.
NORTH COURT: Brake and turn east. Build speed up the gold ramp past the pond.
EAST COURT: Reposition north for the last ramp. The side rail and roaches change your line.
EXIT COURT: One last fast rider circuit before the north gate.

description: Three larger courts, cars and roach patrols. Hold G near a rail to latch; grind above four highway lanes or time the crossing below. Ramps launch over three walls.
